title: Elucidating nano-Cu interactions in grapevine leaves: formulation-dependent foliar affinity, uptake, and leaf persistence over time
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00322A, Paper
Diana Salvador, Matheus Miranda, Sandra Rodrigues, Hiram Castillo-Michel, Cátia Fidalgo, Artur Alves, Mickael Wagner, Camille Larue, Sónia M. Rodrigues, Astrid Avellan
Copper-based nanoformulations allow higher leaf adhesion, targeting specific leaf tissues and improved biocompatibility compared to CuSO4, offering advantages in safer plant protection strategies.
